description: Write proper agile user stories — 'As a… I want… so that…' — with a Given/When/Then acceptance criteria builder. Copy or download.

faqs.a: The role, the goal, and the benefit — the classic 'As a [role], I want [goal], so that [benefit]' format.
Add as many Given/When/Then criteria as you need; each is numbered in the output.
Story points 1–13 (Fibonacci) plus a priority level.
Copy the story or download it as a .txt file for your backlog tool.

howto: Fill in the role, goal, and benefit.
Copy or download your user story.
title: User Story Generator
